dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Take these snacks with you. And this hat I made with Ineffa... And, uh, right! Your horns need some protective oil... Gimme a minute...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The protective oil is with me, Aino. Let me assist.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe. It says, "I'm so lucky to be friends with you."
